speaker: 桐生
sentence: フッ、色々言ってた割には、普通じゃないか。
literal: Heh, for all your fussing, you're talking just fine, aren't you.
official_neighbors: Your tongue seems to be working just fine to me.
Mope! It'f mumb. Cam't tawk!
...Fine. You'll talk if I bring drinks?
Well, first just answer me this. Who out of you has actually done work for Tachibana Real Estate?
Heh, I see. Then at least it looks like I'll get my money's worth.
Oh, and not just ANY booze will do. We get to choose our order, okay?
Tongues are tricky like that. If you don't give 'em exactly what they want, they're just no good.
(It's probably quickest to just give them what they want... I'll take their orders and bring what they tell me to.)
Me, I'll stick with beer.
Heh, after all that talk, I was expecting fancier.
Yeah, well. There's just no beating a beer at the end of a job!
What job?
Whoa, you almost got me there. Nope! First the beer. And I got a bottle opener on me, so I don't care if it's a can or a bottle. Whichever works.
(Okay, beer's easy. They sell that pretty much everywhere.)
Here's your beer.
Ooh, perfect! You're a decent guy for a kid your age!
Beer for me. And I've got a bottle opener, so can or bottle works fine.
prev_official: Your tongue seems to be working just fine to me.
next_official: Beer for me. And I've got a bottle opener, so can or bottle works fine.

speaker: 「ブレンド」のマスター
sentence: 減った客足取り戻さなきゃいけないし、
literal: I've got to win back the customers I've lost, and...
official_candidate: I'm not in anybody's family. And pipe down, it's this guy I'm talking to.
official_neighbors: S-Scared!? Who do you think--
Thanks to you, I had to relocate! Now I'm scrambling to get new customers to make up for all the ones I lost. I couldn't pay you even if I wanted to!
I think you better keep that attitude in check, asshole!
Mind if I cut in?
Huh? ...What do you want?
Who are you? What family you with!?
I'm not in anybody's family. And pipe down, it's this guy I'm talking to.
EXCUSE me!?
Wh-What do you want from me?
You say you opened shop here because Tachibana Real Estate forced you out of your last location? That right?
Oh, I see what this is. You're trying to be this guy's new muscle! Oh hell no!
What?
Our family's handled this cafe's protection for 30 years! You try to swoop in on our turf, it'll mean war!
next_official: Our family's handled this cafe's protection for 30 years!

speaker: 桐生
sentence: なるほど……　わかった。助かったよ。
literal: I see... Understood. You've been a big help.
official_candidate: Hey. Where'd all your other buddies go?
official_neighbors: If he's still there now, Tachibana's boys will be, too. Go have a look if you really want to get mixed up with them.
All right, thanks. I appreciate it.
(Tachibana's been running tenants out of the Hakua Building on Shichifuku Street. It's worth checking out.)
(Looks like this is the place Tachibana Real Estate's been trying to buy up.)
(No business signs... It seems Tachibana's boys live up to the rumors.)
("Namase Bar"... Guess they're the last holdout.)
Hey. Where'd all your other buddies go?
On'ta the next job. They told us this one's all done.
The next job? Where's that?
Who knows? There's lots around. Tachibana-san's got his fingers in all sortsa pies.
Just what kind of outfit is Tachibana Real Estate?
I dunno why yer asking, but you shouldn't mess with them guys. They're the very shadows of this town.
Shadows?
Way I sees it, they're way scarier than any yakuza.
prev_official: If he's still there now, Tachibana's boys will be, too. Go have a look if you really want to get mixed up with them.
next_official: Way I sees it, they're way scarier than any yakuza.

sentence: 相手がヤクザだろうが弱み見つけ出して
literal: Even if they're up against a yakuza, they'll dig up his weak spot—
official_candidate: And that's how they chased off the Jinsei Family?
official_neighbors: Way I sees it, they're way scarier than any yakuza.
They got eyes and ears on every corner here. Whoever ya are, yakuza, doesn't matter. They know yer secrets. Have ya by the balls before ya can blink.
And that's how they chased off the Jinsei Family?
Last I heard, Tojo headquarters made the Jinsei boss hack off a finger.
What?
Came to light he'd been skimming off the top of his payments up the ladder. Anonymous tip.
